name: Vivian Maier – Antologia
description: Discover the captivating street photography of the enigmatic nanny who became a posthumous star of the art world.
longDescription:
"Vivian Maier – Antologia" presents a comprehensive exhibition of the American street photographer's work at the Centro Português de Fotografia. This art exhibition delves into the extensive archive of Maier, a professional nanny whose photographic talent remained largely undiscovered during her lifetime. The collection showcases her unique perspective on urban life, capturing candid moments and everyday scenes primarily across Chicago and New York, offering insight into mid-20th century American society through her lens.

Visitors to the exhibition can expect to explore a curated selection of Maier's black-and-white and color photographs, alongside some of her Super 8 films. The Centro Português de Fotografia, housed in a historic former prison, provides a distinctive and atmospheric backdrop for viewing these works. The exhibition offers a reflective experience, inviting contemplation of Maier's artistic legacy and the stories embedded within her images.

The exhibition runs from April 30th to May 6th, 2026, and is ticketed. The Centro Português de Fotografia is located in the city center, a short walk from São Bento train station and the Ribeira district. It is also accessible via the São Bento metro station.
